data.one_liner: Animates a child between positions in the same route
data.what_it_does: HeroAnimation moves its child from one layout position to another within the same Route. It works in scrollable lists and supports repositioning between tree nodes.
use_when: Need a hero-like animation within a single route
Repositioning items in a list or grid
Animating widgets on tap or state change
avoid_when: Complex physics‑based motion beyond simple repositioning
strengths: Supports both same‑node and different‑node repositioning
